Message.Name: Unit Clear Message
Message.Description: Instructs feed recipients to clear all orders for the CXA book in the unit specified in the Sequenced Unit Header. Distributed in rare recovery events such as a datacentre fail-over.

Message.Name: Trading Status Message
Message.Description: Indicates the current trading status of a security. A Trading Status message will be sent whenever trading status changes for a security.

Field.Name: Trading Status
Field.Description: Trading status of the session for the symbol.

Field.Name: Market Id Code
Field.Description: Market Identifier Code (right padded with spaces).

Message.Name: Add Order Message
Message.Description: Represents a newly accepted visible or undisclosed order on the CXA book. Includes a day-specific Order Id assigned by CXA to the order.

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Day-specific identifier assigned to this order. Order Ids received on PITCH may be compared to those received on order acknowledgements in FIX or BOE by converting the decimal value to a base 36 value.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Number of shares being added to the book. For undisclosed orders, the number of shares is zero.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The display price of the order.

Field.Name: PID
Field.Description: Participant ID (right padded with spaces). Blank (spaces) if not attributed.

Message.Name: Order Executed Message
Message.Description: Sent when a visible order on the CXA book is executed in whole or in part. The execution price equals the order price found in the original Add Order message or the order price in the latest Modify Order message referencing the Order Id.

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Order Id of a previously sent Add Order message that was executed.

Field.Name: Execution Id
Field.Description: CXA generated day-unique execution identifier of this execution. Execution Id is also referenced in the Trade Break message.

Field.Name: Contra Order Id
Field.Description: Order Id of the contra order that matched with this order.

Field.Name: Contra PID
Field.Description: Contra Participant ID (right padded with spaces). Blank (spaces) if not attributed.

Message.Name: Order Executed at Price Message
Message.Description: Used to update lit orders that have fully or partially executed in an auction. There is one Order Executed at Price message per auction trade, which includes the order IDs of both resting orders matched in the trade. Each message is followed by either a Reduce Size message (if the contra order has partially executed) or a Delete Order message (if the contra order has fully executed).

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Order Id of a previously sent Add Order message that was executed.

Field.Name: Execution Id
Field.Description: CXA generated day-unique execution identifier of this execution. Execution Id is also referenced in the Trade Break message.

Field.Name: Contra Order Id
Field.Description: Order Id of the contra order that matched with this order.

Field.Name: Contra PID
Field.Description: Contra Participant ID (right padded with spaces). Blank (spaces) if not attributed.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The execution price of the order.

Message.Name: Reduce Size Message
Message.Description: Sent when a visible order on the CXA book is partially reduced.

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Order Id of a previously sent Add Order message that has been reduced.

Message.Name: Modify Order Message
Message.Description: Sent whenever an open order is visibly modified. The Order Id refers to the Order Id of the original Add Order message. Modify Order messages that appear to be "no ops" (i.e., they do not appear to modify any relevant fields) will still lose priority.

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Order Id of a previously sent Add Order message that has been modified.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Number of shares associated with this order after this modify (may be less than the number entered). For undisclosed orders, the number of shares is zero.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The order price after this modify.

Message.Name: Delete Order Message
Message.Description: Sent whenever a booked order is cancelled or leaves the order book. The Order Id refers to the Order Id of the original Add Order message.

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Order Id of a previously sent Add Order message that has been removed from order book.

Message.Name: Trade Message
Message.Description: Provides information about executions of non-displayed and undisclosed orders (including auction executions of undisclosed orders), on the CXA book or executions that occur off-exchange and reported to CXA. Trade messages for on-exchange electronic executions are necessary to calculate CXA execution-based data. Trade messages do not alter the book and can be ignored if messages are being used solely to build a book.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Incremental number of shares executed or reported.

Field.Name: Execution Id
Field.Description: CXA generated day-unique execution identifier of this execution. Execution Id is also referenced in the Trade Break message.

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Order Id of the executed order.

Field.Name: Contra Order Id
Field.Description: Order Id of the contra order that matched with this order.

Field.Name: PID
Field.Description: Participant ID (right padded with spaces). Blank (spaces) if not attributed.

Field.Name: Contra PID
Field.Description: Contra Participant ID (right padded with spaces). Blank (spaces) if not attributed.

Field.Name: Trade Type
Field.Description: Trade type. Auction executions of Undisclosed orders will include one of O, C, or H.

Field.Name: Trade Designation
Field.Description: Trade designation. Valid only for on-exchange executions, space otherwise.

Field.Name: Trade Report Type
Field.Description: Trade report type. Valid only for off-exchange trade reports, space otherwise.

Field.Name: Trade Transaction Time
Field.Description: Nanosecond timestamp of the off-exchange trade as specified in the Trade Report submitted by the trading participant. Valid only for off-exchange trade reports, zero otherwise.

Message.Name: Trade Break Message
Message.Description: Sent whenever an execution on CXA or off-exchange trade reported to CXA is cancelled. A trade correction is performed by sending a Trade Break message followed by a new Trade message with the corrected size and price. Applications that simply build a CXA book can ignore Trade Break messages.

Field.Name: Execution Id
Field.Description: CXA generated day-unique identifier of the execution that was broken. Execution Id refers to previously sent Order Executed or Trade message.

Message.Name: Calculated Value Message
Message.Description: Sent when CXA calculates market values for a specified symbol or when a calculated market value is reported to CXA. The specified symbol may not trade on CXA, but instead could represent index or iNAV values reported to CXA from third parties as indicated by the Value Category field. The index values will be reported on each of the unitised CXA PITCH feeds and are not specific to an individual unit.

Field.Name: Value Timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp when the calculated value was generated in nanoseconds since epoch.

Message.Name: End of Session Message
Message.Description: Sent for each unit when the unit shuts down. No additional sequenced messages will be delivered for this unit, but heartbeats from the unit may be received.

Message.Name: Auction Update Message
Message.Description: Sent during Pre-Open and Pre-Close trading states when a symbol has an order update relating to an overlapping order book (where the best bid price is greater than or equal to the best ask price). Includes the potential number of shares and the indicative auction price if the symbol were to undergo an auction now. Only sent if there are updates to the Buy Shares, Sell Shares, or Indicative Price fields.

Field.Name: Buy Shares
Field.Description: Number of shares on buy side eligible to trade at the auction indicative price.

Field.Name: Sell Shares
Field.Description: Number of shares on sell side eligible to trade at the auction indicative price.

Field.Name: Indicative Price
Field.Description: Indicative Auction Price at which the continuous book would match.

Message.Name: Auction Summary Message
Message.Description: Sent at the completion of the Auction per symbol and includes the Auction Price and Shares executed. If there is no overlapping order book at the time of the auction, no auction trades will result, but the Auction Summary message will still be disseminated and contain zeroes in the Price and Shares fields.

Field.Name: Shares
Field.Description: Cumulative number of shares executed during the auction.

Value.Name: Trade resulting from normal matching logic
Permitted Trade During Post Trading Hours Period
Permitted Trade During Pre-Trading Hours Period
ETF Trade Report for unit creations or redemptions

Field.Name: Trade from converted order
Field.Description: 0 = Normal trade, 1 = Trade from converted order.
